texto_para_tela: OTHERS: 8 · 6 · OTHER VENOMOUS ARTHROPODS (X25) · ANTS, CATERPILLARS · 2 · VENOMOUS MARINE ANIMALS (X26) · JELLYFISH, CORAL, SEA ANEMONES
credito_sugerido: Source: ABS, Causes of Death, Australia, 2025 (CC BY 4.0); WHO, ICD-10 (2019)
nota: Os rótulos de tela do ABS: 'Contact with other specified venomous arthropods (X25)' e 'Contact with venomous marine animals and plants (X26)'. A CID-10 (2019) dá os exemplos: X25 'Incl.: ant, caterpillar'; X26 'Incl.: coral, jellyfish, nematocysts, sea anemone' (relidos na cópia). Os dois do X26 são de 2021 e 2022; nenhum deles é do NT (Table 8.2: X26 = 0 nos dez anos).

texto_aprovado: If you're adding along, that leaves eight deaths. Most of them are filed under what the death codes call "other venomous arthropods," and the examples the code gives are ants and caterpillars. The rest are filed under venomous marine animals, a heading that covers jellyfish, coral and sea anemones. The records don't say which animal it was.
